guitar.notes: Matt Bellamy is famous for custom Manson guitars with built-in effects; entry accurate (minor model-name fix: MBM not MBC).

tone.target: fuzzy synth-like bass riff with bright attack and tight low end
tone.profile: fuzzy synth-like bass riff with bright attack and tight low end
tone.summary: Fuzz -> Boost (optional) -> Amp (US Deluxe for clarity) -> Cab (US 2x12) -> EQ -> Compressor -> Tremolo (subtle modulation).
corrections: Replace generic high-gain crunch with fuzzy synth-bass texture.
Drop chorus/flanger and dotted delay; they are not core here.
Keep it tight, dry, and synth-like, not big rock sustain.

rig.name: Muse - Supermassive Black Hole - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Tighten the low end and eliminate hum from aggressive fuzz tones.
Slightly boost the signal before fuzz to ensure maximum output and punch.
Provide the core fuzzy synth-bass texture and aggressive saturation.
Provide a clear, articulate platform for the fuzzy bass tone without excessive grit.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is chosen over UK models to maintain clarity and tightness required for synth-bass emulation.

blocks.purpose: Emulate a smaller, tighter cabinet sound suitable for focused bass tones.
blocks.gap: No specific 1x12 is available; US 2x12 provides the necessary focus and clarity.

blocks.purpose: Sculpt the frequency response to emphasize tight low-end punch and bright attack.
Achieve tight gated sustain and even out the dynamic range of the fuzzy bass lines.
Add subtle movement to the synth-like texture without sounding like a classic chorus effect.
blocks.gap: Tremolo is used instead of Chorus/Flanger as per 'avoid' list, providing controlled modulation.

blocks.purpose: Provide minimal ambient space and prevent the tone from sounding completely dry.
blocks.gap: The requirement is 'minimal room,' so a low mix of Room reverb is used, avoiding big decay times.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the generic US 2x12 IR for a more focused, tight-sounding 1x12 or specialized bass cab to better capture the synth/bass texture.

proposals.reason: The tone requires extreme tightness and focus, which a generic US 2x12 may lack. A specialized 1x12 will enhance the synth-bass clarity.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased definition and punch in the low end.
